source_universe.note: Not 768 independent ecological replicates. 64 candidates reuse each of 12 fixed landscapes.

alias_findings.note: Different A/B/M masks can share the same realized G; geometry computed from G cannot distinguish those histories.

spatial_vs_environmental_component_count.note: Geographic binary rook components at fixed threshold 0.5 versus descriptive environmental MST-cut components are different estimands. No real dispersal or ecological fragmentation inference.

observations_after_protocol_freeze: All 12 source systems qualified under the original activation contract.
All 768 world G supports had at least two nodes and were estimable.
All G-derived geometry and spatial component values were invariant across the same G masks.
The 12 system medians of matched log G/U span ratios were negative.
The comparison between original MST-cut and binary geographic connected components disagreed for 241/768 candidate worlds.
strict_limits: This is retrospective geometry scoring over previously exposed virtual worlds, not independent confirmatory ecological evidence.
Matched-size resampling quantiles are sampling sensitivity, not confidence intervals.
G vs superset log spans are not causal A/B/M contributions.
All G points used as ideal anchors and constant-one raster are synthetic controls, not a fitted SDM.
No frozen EOG-WF, BAM identifiability, or independent ecological publication outcome was changed.
